title: Grateful Dead Live at Barton Hall on 1977-05-08
source: source: aud taped by Jerry Moore; 1)cassette master>10.5" reel @ 7.5 ips, dolby b provides a majority of the show, 2)Scarlet>Fire provided by cassette master patched from same rig>JM's cassette>reel (as above) 3)The One More Sat Nite encore is from the newly discovered original cassette master; lineage for source 1 (with exceptions noted above): aud cassette master: sony ecm 33p's>sony tc-153, maxell udxLII90's/dolby b>aud 1st gen: made on Sony TC-755 w/Teac an-180 dolby unit, Scotch Classic 10.5" reels; transfer: technics rs-1506 open reel>teac an-180 dolby b unit>tascam hd-p2 24/96>flac; encore: nak dragon>tascam hd-p2 24/96>pc>flac; new transfers by Rob Berger spring 2011; mastering, pitch correction, and seeded by Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: An exquisitely restored audience recording of a legendary May ’77 show, highlighted by soaring renditions of Morning Dew and Scarlet/Fire.
ai_review.review: The Moore‑Miller restoration brings this mysterious May 1977 performance to vivid life, delivering crystal‑clear sound that lets the band’s magic shine through. Reviewers rave about the transcendent moments—especially the climactic Morning Dew and the fiery Scarlet/Fire sequence—while noting the recording’s lush, vibrant quality. The show is repeatedly called “great” and “terrific,” with no reported flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, uniformly praising both the musical performance and the restored audio; the show is described as legendary and the recording as lustrous, warranting a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Restored by Charlie Miller to sound lush and vibrant; reviewers call it “lustrous,” “vibrant,” and note the clean, crisp presentation despite being an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a uniquely compelling performance that stands out among May ’77 dates, with a seamless flow and powerful climaxes.
